verdict.rationale: smolagents ships CLI utilities (smolagent, webagent) that let a user directly run a prebuilt agent to delegate tasks without writing code, and agent.run() shows immediate task delegation, but the product is fundamentally a framework for building custom agents rather than a product with a persistent built-in assistant experience. missing for 10: a first-party hosted/embedded assistant UI, evidence of end-user (non-developer) delegation flow, and independent hands-on confirmation of the CLI assistant's real-world task delegation quality.
